name: TCM IDrive Index
description: Indexes an IDrive e2 S3 bucket into a local SQLite store and writes per-folder summaries into OpenClaw's memory directory. Exposes the openclaw tcm idrive ... CLI and an idrive_find tool.

endpoint.description: IDrive e2 endpoint URL, e.g. https://s3.us-east-1.idrivee2.com

accessKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding IDrive e2 access key.

secretKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding IDrive e2 secret key.

dataDir.description: Local directory for SQLite index and scratch state.

memoryDir.description: Where to drop folder-summary markdown files for OpenClaw memory indexer. Empty disables.
